note: Offline demonstration articles assembled from public official guidance links. Claims are generic and evergreen; no live prices, stock or member data.

articles.title: How to book concert tickets in Berlin
articles.summary: Use the venue or an authorised agency, confirm the official seller on the event page, then check access and travel before paying.

claims.text: Start at the venue's own programme or the Berlin events calendar, then follow the official ticket link shown for that event.
Eventim is an authorised ticketing agency in Germany; check that the seller named on the event page matches the checkout before paying.
Check the venue page for doors, age limits, accessibility and bag rules, which vary by show.

articles.title: Getting to Berlin concert venues by public transport
articles.summary: Plan the journey with BVG or S-Bahn Berlin and allow extra time for evening events.

claims.text: Use the BVG journey planner for U-Bahn, tram and bus connections to the venue.
Check S-Bahn service updates before travelling; engineering works can change the last connection.

articles.title: UK weather forecast sources
articles.summary: The BBC and the Met Office publish current conditions, forecasts and warnings; Pulse Search links to them rather than restating a live value.

claims.text: Use BBC Weather for city forecasts and the Met Office for the official UK forecast and weather warnings.
Treat a forecast as guidance, not a guarantee; warnings and local conditions can change during the day.

articles.title: Germany weather forecast sources
articles.summary: The Deutscher Wetterdienst is Germany's national weather service for forecasts, warnings and climate information.

claims.text: Use the DWD for national warnings and forecasts, and the city or state service for local information.

articles.title: Pride and CSD festivals in Germany
articles.summary: German Pride events are usually organised city by city as CSD or Christopher Street Day; use the city calendar and the local Pride organisation to confirm dates.

claims.text: Look for CSD or Christopher Street Day listings in each city; programmes and dates are published by local organisers.
Check the organiser's own page for route, accessibility and any changes before travelling.

articles.title: London New Year's Eve fireworks
articles.summary: The Mayor of London publishes the official event and ticketing arrangements; check Transport for London before travelling.

claims.text: Check the Mayor of London's official page for the event announcement, viewing areas and ticket arrangements.
Plan travel with TfL and expect road closures and busy stations on the night.

articles.title: Where to buy flight tickets
articles.summary: Buy directly from the airline or a licensed agent so fare rules, baggage and changes are clear.

claims.text: Compare the airline's own site with a licensed agent, and check who the seller is before paying.
Check ATOL or ABTA protection where it applies, and read the fare rules for changes and refunds.

articles.title: Ticket refunds and cancellations
articles.summary: Consumer rights and the seller's terms both matter; check official guidance and the terms shown at purchase.

claims.text: Check the seller's terms and the official consumer guidance for the country of purchase before disputing a charge.
For a cancelled event, contact the original seller; resale sites may not offer the same protection.

articles.title: Glastonbury Festival 2027
articles.summary: Glastonbury returns in 2027 after a fallow year, at Worthy Farm in Somerset.

claims.text: The 2027 festival is scheduled from Wednesday 23 to Sunday 27 June 2027.
The festival is held at Worthy Farm, Pilton, Somerset; use the organiser's travel guidance.

articles.title: London Parade 2027
articles.summary: London Parade is the New Year's Day parade in central London; the organiser publishes the route, timing and participant information.

claims.text: Use the organiser's official site for the current route, start time and road closures.
Check TfL for travel changes on the day and plan around central London closures.

articles.title: Berlin Christmas markets
articles.summary: Berlin's Christmas markets usually run through Advent; the city calendar lists current markets and opening periods.

claims.text: Check the Berlin city calendar for current Christmas market listings and opening periods.
Plan travel to the markets with BVG and confirm opening times and entry conditions on the organiser's page before travelling.
